analyst.summary: Shaily has delivered standout growth -- 26% revenue growth and 83% profit growth in FY26 -- driven by genuine operating leverage as margins expanded from 15% to 28% over four years, alongside new global retail-client wins. But margins are now high enough that further profit growth will likely track revenue growth more closely rather than outpace it as dramatically, and working capital use has increased as the business has scaled. At roughly 73x earnings, the stock is priced for continued exceptional execution, leaving limited room for a slower year.
